title: Innkeeper
motivations: find out who keeps stealing the spoons
greet: 'Sit, sit! You look like you've walked through a hedge backwards.'
'Rooms are three silver. Stew is free if you don't ask what's in it.'
ask: 'Rats in the cellar again. Big ones.'
'My delivery cart never arrived. Could you look?'

title: Blacksmith
motivations: get rare ore from the mountains
pay off a debt to the guild
greet: 'Mind the anvil. And the sparks. And the dog.'
'If it's broken, I fix it. If it's not, I'll sell you a better one.'
ask: 'Bring me star-iron from the old mine and I'll make you something special.'

title: Hermit
motivations: warn the world about a coming darkness
greet: 'Visitors. Hmph. Wipe your feet on the moss.'
'I saw you coming three days ago. In a dream. You were taller.'
ask: 'The spirits are restless. Something in the ruins has woken.'

title: Travelling Merchant
motivations: find a buyer for a cursed item
greet: 'Friends! Customers! Friends who are customers!'
'Everything must go. Some of it is even legal.'
ask: 'Escort me through the pass and I'll make it worth your while.'

title: Noble
greet: 'Adventurers. How... rustic.'
'You may approach. Not too close.'
ask: 'My heirloom ring was stolen by brigands. Retrieve it, discreetly.'

title: Guard Captain
motivations: keep the peace with too few soldiers
greet: 'State your business. Quickly — I've got three fires and a goat riot.'
ask: 'Bandits on the east road. I can't spare a single soldier. You, though...'

title: Priest
motivations: protect the town from the undead
greet: 'Blessings upon you. You look like you need several.'
ask: 'The old graveyard is... restless. Please, put them back to sleep.'

title: Rival Bard
motivations: be more famous than the party
write the ballad of the century
greet: 'Oh, it's YOU. I suppose they'll write songs about you too. Short ones.'
ask: 'Do something heroic. I need material.'

title: Pickpocket
motivations: pull off one last big job
greet: 'Psst. Nice purse. Shame if someone... complimented it.'
ask: 'Help me lift a ledger from the tax office. For the people. And for me.'

title: Farmer
motivations: get rid of whatever's in the barn
greet: 'You lot aren't from the tax office, are you?'
ask: 'Something's been eating my sheep. Something BIG.'

title: Hedge Witch
motivations: settle an old score with a rival hag
greet: 'Come in, dearies. Don't touch the jars. Especially that one.'
ask: 'Fetch me a moonpetal from the haunted glade and I'll brew you something nice.'

title: Knight-Errant
motivations: prove their courage after a disgrace
greet: 'Hail, fellow travellers! Have you seen a dragon? Or a horse?'
ask: 'Join me on a glorious quest! It's mostly glorious.'

title: Scholar
greet: 'Fascinating. Are you a specimen or a visitor?'
ask: 'Copy the inscriptions in the ruins for me. Carefully. Accurately. Please.'

title: Ranger
greet: 'You walk like a herd of cattle. Follow me — quietly.'
ask: 'There's a beast in the woods killing everything. Help me hunt it.'

title: Fortune Teller
motivations: see the end of a prophecy
warn the party of their fate
greet: 'Sit. Cross my palm with silver. The cards are... troubled.'
ask: 'Find the one whose face is on this card. Before it's too late.'

title: Alchemist
motivations: find a cure for a plague
greet: 'Don't mind the smoke. Or the smell. Or the screaming. That's normal.'
ask: 'I need troll fat. Fresh. Ideally still attached.'

title: Lost Child
greet: 'Are you heroes? You look like heroes. Mostly.'
ask: 'Can you help me find my way home? It's past the scary woods.'

title: Restless Ghost
greet: 'Oooh... you can see me? Finally!'
ask: 'Find my locket and bury it with my bones. Please.'

title: Talking Animal
motivations: be turned back into a person
greet: 'Yes, I can talk. No, I won't do tricks.'
ask: 'Find the wizard who did this to me. I have WORDS for them.'

title: Retired Adventurer
motivations: warn the young about a dungeon
greet: 'Back in my day we fought dragons uphill. Both ways.'
ask: 'My old party left something in the crypt. I'm too old. You're not.'

title: Smuggler
motivations: get revenge on a mutinous crew
greet: 'Ahoy. You're not navy, are ye? Good. Drink?'
ask: 'Help me get my cargo past the patrol and you'll have a share.'

title: Tax Collector
greet: 'Adventurers? Then you have income. Then you have taxes.'
ask: 'The tax chest was stolen. If you return it... I'll forget your arrears.'

title: Cult Defector
motivations: stop the ritual from the inside
greet: 'Shh! They're looking for me. I know things. Useful things.'
ask: 'Get me to safety and I'll tell you how to weaken the enemy.'

title: Miner
greet: 'Mind your heads. Mind your feet. Mind everything, really.'
ask: 'My crew is trapped below. Something's down there with them.'
